display.summary: First 1.10 beta: projects' settings join first-run setup and can share one tile, tiles ask before discarding edits, and an optional weather widget arrives.
highlights: Project settings tiles appear as a Project Settings step at the end of first-run setup, saved with the rest of the wizard.
register_app_settings_group() folds several project settings into one tile, edited and saved together.
Closing a project settings tile with unsaved edits now asks first.
Optional OpenWeather widgets for the titlebar, user hub, a floating chip or project dashboards, configured under Extra Features.
